'''Yury Aleksandrovich Brychkov''' ({{langx|ru|Юрий Александрович Брычков}}; born 29 February 1944 in [[Moscow]], [[Russia]]) is a Russian [[mathematician]].

He graduated from [[Moscow State University]] in 1966 and worked on [[quantum field theory]] at the [[Steklov Mathematical Institute]] of the [[Russian Academy of Sciences]], under the supervision of [[Yurii Shirokov|Yuri Mikhailovich Shirokov]]. He received his PhD in 1971 and he has been with the [[Dorodnicyn Computing Centre]] of the [[Russian Academy of Sciences]] since 1969.

Yu. A. Brychkov has worked on various topics of [[pure mathematics]], and he has made contributions to the fields of [[special functions]] and [[integral transforms]]. He has also worked on the computer implementation of special functions at the [[University of Waterloo]],<ref name="University of Waterloo Phone Directory">{{cite web|url=https://ist.uwaterloo.ca/phone/2002Sep_Telephone.pdf|title=University of Waterloo: Telephone Directory, September 2002|publisher=Information Systems & Technology, University of Waterloo|access-date=2018-05-10}}</ref> [[Maplesoft]], and [[Wolfram Research]].<ref name="Wolfram Research">{{cite web|url=http://blog.wolfram.com/author/yury-brychkov/|title=Wolfram Blog: Author Index: Yury Brychkov|publisher=Wolfram|access-date=2018-05-10}}</ref> He is a founding editor of the ''Journal of Integral Transforms and Special Functions'',<ref name="Journal of Integral Transforms and Special Functions">{{cite journal|title=Integral Transforms and Special Functions: Editorial Board|journal = Integral Transforms and Special Functions|volume = 26|issue = 12|pages = ebi|doi=10.1080/10652469.2015.1088624|year = 2015}}</ref> and has authored a number of handbooks, including the five volume ''Integrals and Series'' (Gordon and Breach Science Publishers, 1986–1992).<ref name="Integrals and series">{{cite book|title=Integrals and series / A.P. Prudnikov, Yu. A. Brychkov, O.I. Marichev; translated from the Russian by N.M. Queen|publisher=New York Gordon & Breach|isbn=9782881240973|year=1986}}</ref>
